description: This file defines an abstract interface class 'StorageAdapter' for a telemetry storage backend, designed for a predictive maintenance system. It specifies methods for initializing storage, managing assets, telemetry records, and alerts, serving as a contract for concrete implementations.

classes.name: StorageAdapter
classes.description: An abstract base class defining the interface for different storage backend implementations in the system.

methods.name: None init(self)
methods.description: Initialize the storage backend, e.g., create tables or run migrations.

methods.name: list[Asset] seed_sample_assets(self)
methods.description: Ensure some sample assets exist, returning the list of assets.

methods.name: Asset create_asset(self, asset_id: str, name: str, type: str)
methods.description: Create and return a new asset with specified id, name, and type.

methods.name: Asset|None get_asset(self, asset_id: str)
methods.description: Fetch a single asset by ID, returning None if not found.

methods.name: list[Asset] list_assets(self)
methods.description: Return a list of all assets.

methods.name: int insert_telemetry(self, record: TelemetryRecord)
methods.description: Insert a telemetry record into storage, returning its database ID.

methods.name: list[dict[str,Any]] list_telemetry( self, asset_id: str, start: datetime | None = None, end: datetime | None = None, limit: int = 500, )
methods.description: Retrieve telemetry records for a specific asset, optionally filtered by time range and limited in number.

methods.name: Alert create_alert(self, asset_id: str, severity: AlertSeverity, message: str)
methods.description: Create and return an alert associated with an asset.

methods.name: list[Alert] list_alerts(self, asset_id: str | None = None, limit: int = 200)
methods.description: Retrieve list of alerts, optionally filtered by asset ID.

methods.name: Alert|None ack_alert(self, alert_id: str, acked_by: str, ack_comment: str | None)
methods.description: Acknowledge an alert, returning the updated alert or None if not found.
